empty.title: Create a project to get started
empty.text: A project gathers several files in one place, always available to its chats. You can choose whether to create an anonymised project or a normal one.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this project?
confirmDelete.text: “{{name}}”, its files, its chats and its placeholder registry will be permanently removed from this server.

dialog.title: New project
dialog.description: Choose the type of project to create. Once selected, it can no longer be changed.
dialog.policyRequired: Your administrator has made anonymisation mandatory: this project will be created anonymised.

anon.title: Anonymised project
anon.l1: Every uploaded file is anonymised, then has to be reviewed and confirmed.
anon.l2: Chats in the project only see the anonymised files, and share the same placeholders.
anon.l3: You can upload documents with extractable text or with images.

plain.title: Standard project
plain.l1: Files are saved exactly as they are, with no anonymisation.
plain.l2: So the chats in the project see the original files.
plain.l3: Pay close attention to the content you upload.

categories.title: Categories to anonymise
categories.help: These apply to every file and every chat in the project. Specific terms still apply: your administrator's and your own (Settings).
